GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay the hampered & Settled Down 4 Lengths on fence, little change to 4.5 Lengths rail turning, Held Up home turn then shifted around heels Straightening Up , behind horses early in straight, reefed out wider at the 250m and ran on hitting Lead 50-or-60m from post # ran on well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping, was hampered when carried out across the heels of a runner. Held up rounding the home turn until shortly after the entrance to the straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly, missed start 1 length & Settled Down 9 Lengths on fence, railed to 8 Lengths turning, Made Some Ground in straight. [Stewards questioned jockey re his riding in the straight. Stewards noted his explanation.] # never a factor
Jumped Ok well back Settled Down 2nd last 10 Lengths 600m 9th 7 Lengths home turn 9th 6 Lengths took inside run Straight Kept Going Ok # honest effort

Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 6.5 Lengths on fence, tightened 800m, railed up to 5 Lengths turning, improved only very marginally in straight. [Stewards questioned rider re performance. Jockey stated it settled slightly further back than anticipated, travelled fairly but failed to sprint strongly and was dour to the line, racing like a tired horse. Trainer stated it had had a heavy racing schedule this preparation and raced flat. He stated he would freshen it up prior to its next start. Post-race vet exam did not reveal any abnormality.] # never featured
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping. Steadied when tightened for room near 800m. Steadied after improving onto heels rounding h/turn. Momentarily held up on heels near 200m. Rdr stated mount settled slightly further back than anticipated after receiving interference near 800m. Rdr stated mount travelled fairly from this point however failed to sprint strongly on straightening & was dour to line. Rdr stated mount raced like a tired horse. Tnr stated mare has had a heavy race schedule and raced flat. Tnr to freshen up prior to next start. P/R vet no ab's.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 4l off, pushed along turn, Straightened Up 3-4l off, kept on one pace # held ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Knuckled shortly after jumping. Raced keenly through the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 3 Lengths Two Wide , Checked 0.5 Lengths at 800m, Drifted Back to 3.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, improved only marginally in straight. [Stewards: Travelled keenly early stages.] # Checked mid-race
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Travelled keenly in the early stages. Steadied to obtain cover near the 1000m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back 5l off, swung Wide turn, Straightened Up 3l off all clear, worked home well without threatening # tempo against
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and with cover throughout the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths on fence, shuffled back to 5 Lengths rail turning, Hooked Out 3 Wide Straightening Up and ran on in Straight making good ground late. (Tongue Tie AGAIN) [Stewards questioned rider re her riding early in home straight. App. jockey's explanation was noted.] # ran on well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding riding in early parts of home straight & whether opportunity improve into run between rnrs. App. Rep by master stated after being held up rounding home turn had endeavoured shift out upon straightening obtain clear running. Once straightening had viewed a run present between rnrs however felt rnrs were shifting ground & if had pressured for run would have been disappointed & continually held up. Therefore endeavouring to continue with initial plans to shift wider.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 1 length 3 Wide , in Two Wide Outside Lead at 750m, held together much same to turn Two Wide trailing a half length, kept trying but failed to improve and only Held Ground in Straight # wide/worked early
Bit Slow Out bustled, settled back 6l off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up well off, kept on one pace # weak run home
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was crowded shortly after jumping between rnrs

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 3l off, held together turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off all clear, battled on one pace # did enough
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid out rounding the home turn and whilst under pressure in the home straight. Passing the 200m was crowded whilst continuing to lay out when another runner had shifted in slightly.
